title: Launch mass margin
message: Only {value}% margin between your wet mass and what the rocket can deliver (want ≥ {threshold}%). Parts almost always get heavier before launch.
fixHint: Drop an instrument, choose a lower-energy trajectory, or book a bigger rocket.

title: Power margin at end of mission
message: Power margin is {value}% at end of mission (want ≥ {threshold}%). Solar panels degrade every year.
fixHint: Add solar array area, switch to triple-junction cells, or cut power-hungry parts.

title: Battery through eclipse
message: Battery margin through the longest eclipse is {value}% (want ≥ {threshold}%).
fixHint: Pick a bigger battery or an orbit with shorter shadows.

title: Data return
message: Your instruments generate more data than you can send home (margin {value}%).
fixHint: Bigger dish, stronger transmitter, Ka-band, more DSN hours — or fewer data-hungry instruments.

title: Cost cap
message: You are {value}% under the cost cap. Over the cap, the mission cannot be selected.
fixHint: Descope instruments, pick a cheaper rocket, or shorten operations.

title: Budget reserves
message: You are holding {value}% reserves (want ≥ {threshold}%). Reserves pay for the surprises that always come.
fixHint: Raise the reserve slider — it may mean cutting something else.

title: Radiation design margin
message: Your electronics can take {value}% more than the predicted dose (want ≥ {threshold}% — a margin of 2×).
fixHint: Use radiation-hardened avionics or add shielding / a vault.

title: Science coverage
message: Nominal design returns {value}% of the baseline science (want ≥ {threshold}%).
fixHint: Check which objectives have no instrument, or which are starved of downlink.

title: Probability of surviving the primary mission
message: Estimated {value}% chance of no mission-ending failure (want ≥ {threshold}%).
fixHint: Add redundancy to computers and pointing, or raise the assurance level.
